dct_description_sm: The dataset is an archive of twice-daily numerical outputs from Environment Canada's GEM model. The data is intended to provide background meteorological information to researchers who require it in interpretation of their research data collection. Most of the parameters archived are surface and near-surface variables, but including elements such as up and downward radiation fluxes.
dct_title_s: Canadian Meteorological Centre gridded Numerical Dataset - Global Environmental Multiscale (GEM) model
